findings.actual: Apply accepts split filesystems; restore and recovery both raise EXDEV after stop; prior program and selected profile remain live; no start.
findings.expected: Reject unsupported archive filesystems before stop or mutation, or preserve targets on their filesystem.
findings.proposed_correction: Preflight profile and baseline archive filesystem constraints before apply and restore/recover mutation, or use durable per-filesystem archives.
findings.title: Cross-filesystem profile archive blocks restore and recovery after swap

findings.actual: Edit at installed rename boundary causes final refusal; gateway events only stop; manifest restoring; program prior.
findings.expected: Preserve late edit and leave coherent selected state with restarted gateway or actionable recovery.
findings.proposed_correction: Coordinate exception recovery around final check and directory swaps; restore selected state and restart before profile mutation; expose recovery after partial mutation.
findings.title: Final profile check refuses after program swap without restart

findings.actual: Worker writes failed; status retains failed plus restoring; authenticated recover route returns 409.
findings.expected: Exited worker with restoring snapshot retains authorized recovery route.
findings.probe_limit: Injected exception at worker boundary; real exception handler and local password-authenticated API; no live systemd.
findings.proposed_correction: Derive recovery-required status from validated transaction and inactive worker, including failed worker status; preserve retry of unchanged applied snapshots.
findings.title: Worker failure status hides recoverable restore from browser recovery
